prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a hit while turning left in Sugar Land, Texas, and has whiplash. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1002; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the collision you were involved in while turning left in Sugar Land. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather just leave my name out of the recording, if that's all right. You already have my file.
Q: That's fine. Can you describe where you were heading when the collision happened?
A: I was driving through an intersection on a main road, turning left onto a side street toward a shopping area.
Q: What was the traffic signal showing when you began your turn?
A: It had turned yellow while I was approaching, and I was already in the intersection when it changed. I had a gap in oncoming traffic, so I started my turn.
Q: Did you see the other vehicle before the impact?
A: Not clearly. I saw headlights coming toward me, but I thought there was more room than there was. The impact came from the front passenger side of my car.
Q: How fast were you traveling when you started the turn?
A: Slowly, I think. Maybe fifteen or twenty miles an hour. I was braking for the light, so I wasn't moving fast.
Q: Were you wearing your seatbelt?
A: Yes, I was.
Q: Did you get out of the vehicle at the scene or go to a medical facility afterward?
A: I stayed in the car for a few minutes, then got out. I felt stiff right away. A paramedic checked me, and I went to urgent care the same evening.
Q: Can you describe the injuries you are currently experiencing?
A: My neck hurts, especially when I turn my head to check my blind spots. I've had headaches and some pain between my shoulder blades. I've been doing physical therapy twice a week.
Q: Is there anything else you would like to add to your statement?
A: Only that I'm trying to get back to normal and I'm still having trouble sleeping because of the pain.
Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
